name: Belaya pyl i Snezhnaya ten
source:
December 1998. Petersburg.
Ivan, who has no last name, is a quiet, withdrawn teenager from an orphanage, accustomed to accepting life like a snowfall: inevitable, cold, and indifferent. He lives between gray buildings and his own fears, until one day a girl named Slavya appears on a winter bench.

Sunny, lively, and so out of place in the cold city. Their "white nights" consist of quiet meetings in a snow-covered park, conversations about books and music, a first timid affection, and mutual healing.
Over three winter weeks, Ivan will manage to open his heart in a way he had been afraid to do his entire life. Bright walks, hot tea, snowfalls, laughter, despair, and that very feeling that arrives quietly, barely audibly. That is exactly how love arrives.
But February is inevitable, and miracles do not happen.
And Slavya, too, will have to take a step that changes everything.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3602826967]Steam[/url]]
translation:
1998年12月，圣彼得堡。
伊万没有姓氏，是一个来自孤儿院的安静、孤僻的少年，习惯于接受生活如降雪般：不可避免、冷漠、冷漠。他生活在灰色的建筑和自己的恐惧之间，直到有一天，一个名叫斯拉维亚的女孩出现在冬天的长凳上。

阳光明媚，热闹非凡，与寒冷的城市格格不入。他们的“白夜”包括在白雪覆盖的公园里安静的会面、关于书籍和音乐的对话、最初的胆怯的感情以及相互治愈。
在冬季的三个星期里，伊万将设法以一种他一生都不敢做的方式敞开心扉。明亮的散步、热茶、降雪、欢笑、绝望，以及那种悄然降临的感觉，几乎听不见。爱情就是这样到来的。
但二月是不可避免的，奇迹不会发生。
斯拉维亚也必须迈出改变一切的一步。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3602826967]Steam[/url]]
